title: Generator Range
description:
Implement a `range` generator function. With one argument it yields `0` to `end` (exclusive). With two arguments, from `start` to `end`. With three, uses `step`.

**Example:**
```js
[...range(3)];         // [0, 1, 2]
[...range(1, 4)];      // [1, 2, 3]
[...range(0, 10, 3)];  // [0, 3, 6, 9]
```
ai_context: Common mistake: not handling the single-argument case where `end` is undefined and `start` becomes the true end. Students also sometimes use `return` instead of `yield` inside the loop.
